assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and exertional dyspnea in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
The patient has atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10).
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0).
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate intermittent symptoms with potential arrhythmias and to assess the efficacy of current rate-control management.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is coded as CPT 93229.
The service addresses intermittent symptoms and ongoing rate-control evaluation documented in the clinical indication.
The service meets the medical necessity criteria for this diagnostic modality.
